patches.name: Custom Maps API Key
patches.description: Replace Transit Google Maps key with your own Android Maps SDK key for re-signed APKs.

patches.name: Custom AdMob Credentials
patches.description: Sign in with your own Google OAuth client and refresh token instead of the Google Sign-In flow, which a re-signed APK cannot use.

options.title: OAuth client secret
options.description: Client secret of your own Google OAuth client.

options.title: OAuth refresh token
options.description: Refresh token issued to that client for the admob.readonly scope.

options.title: AdMob publisher id
options.description: Your AdMob publisher id, for example pub-0000000000000000.

options.title: Account email
options.description: Email shown for the account. Only a label.

options.title: Report time zone
options.description: Time zone the AdMob reports are requested in.

options.title: Report currency
options.description: Currency the AdMob earnings are labelled with.

patches.name: Custom OAuth Client ID
patches.description: Send your own OAuth client id with the token requests. Use together with Custom AdMob Credentials, with the client the refresh token was issued to.

options.title: OAuth client id
options.description: Client id of your own Google OAuth client.

patches.name: Disable Ad Requests
patches.description: Clear the AdMob ad unit ids so no ad is ever requested from the network.

patches.name: Hide Ads
patches.description: Hide the native ads shown on the home, apps, app info and mediation screens.

patches.name: Pro Features Unlock
patches.description: Unlock all pro features in Transit

patches.name: Pro Unlock
patches.description: Unlock all pro features in AdMobile.
